findings.evidence: Both models retain actionable native state across a terminal server/call transition. In notification-native-action, native_answer -> server_cancel -> auth_ready -> react_ready -> consume_action ends cancelled but records the action as consumed with no violation. In chat-call, invite -> native_action -> cancel -> auth_ready -> react_ready -> consume_native ends cancelled but consumes action-1 with no violation.
findings.impact: The T2 model can report MODEL_CLEAR while stale Answer state survives terminal cancel/timeout/decline and is consumed later. This does not prove the required exact terminal cleanup or replay denial and leaves the historical lost/stale-action class incompletely prevented.
findings.requiredResolution: Clear or terminally deny every pending native action when a call becomes cancelled, declined, timed out, busy, or ended; prohibit consumption after any terminal state; add current and historical fixtures plus deterministic accept/cancel/timeout action interleavings.

findings.evidence: receive_push(mustReport=true) followed by server_timeout leaves the call terminal, CallKit unreported, the push uncompleted, and violations empty. The invariant only rejects a completed push lacking a report, while the fixed transition refuses such completion, so the obligation can remain outstanding indefinitely and MODEL_CLEAR.
findings.impact: The earlier must-report P1 is not fully corrected: a guard that makes the violating completion unreachable substitutes rejection for proof that every must-report push is reported and completed exactly once.
findings.requiredResolution: Represent a bounded outstanding must-report obligation and an explicit terminal/evaluation transition that fails unless CallKit report and completion obligations were satisfied exactly once. Add a fixed positive witness and hostile missed-report schedules.

findings.evidence: There are six model domains but transitionWitnesses defines only chat-call, livekit, and notification-native-action. runPropertyModels computes clearance with witnesses.every(...), which is true for an empty list, and the test likewise loops an empty list without asserting at least one reached witness.
findings.impact: RevenueCat, OTA/build, and migration domains can claim MODEL_CLEAR after generated commands that are all rejected or never reach the authoritative success state. This is a fail-open T2 proof and only partially resolves the prior vacuous-property P1.
findings.requiredResolution: Require one or more declared positive witnesses for every selected model domain, assert each reaches a domain-specific authoritative state, and fail MODEL_CLEAR when witness coverage is absent. Retain deterministic random properties in addition to these non-vacuity witnesses.

findings.evidence: The authoritative current-truth record and generated CURRENT_STATE.md still bind open PR #64 to 13ff4c0ffc1c38f402dc1bf7744758d6419b151b, while this exact review binds 01ad30e4e0143cc4586b6d1be93c650ed753fd38. current-truth.mjs returns PASS and emits no stale open-implementation-head finding.
findings.impact: The exact class this assurance layer is meant to prevent remains present at the frozen review head. A passing current-truth command is not evidence that the open implementation inventory is current, so merge eligibility would accept stale hot-path truth.
findings.requiredResolution: The coordinator must update the authoritative current-truth record and generated hot-path documents at a coherent exact-head boundary, and the guard must fail closed when a tracked open implementation head differs from current evidence. Any implementation-head change invalidates this review.

findings.evidence: The exact PR delta is now fully classified after adding _lib/assurance to CI-test-infrastructure, but pr-scope.mjs still records an empty domains array without adding a finding for an arbitrary future unclassified source path.

findings.requiredResolution: In PR E, reject every unclassified changed source path unless a bounded policy explicitly marks it documentation or generated non-source evidence; add regression tests proving supporting files cannot conceal an unknown source path.
